description_en: Queries the execution status and result of a video task by calling the GetVideoTask operation
description_zh: 调用GetVideoTask接口查询视频任务的执行状态和结果
kebab_example: aliyun imm get-video-task --project immvideotest --task-type CompressVideoTask --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetVideoTask

parameters.help_en:
The type of the task. Valid values:

CompressVideoTask: video compression task.

GrabFrameTask: video frame capture task
parameters.help_zh:
任务的类型，包含如下选项：

CompressVideoTask：视频压缩任务。

GrabFrameTask：视频截帧任务
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The task ID. The task ID must correspond to the task type.

This parameter is the Task ID returned after you call the CreateVideoCompressTask (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144048.html) or CreateGrabFrameTask (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199047.html) operation
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。设置的任务ID必须与任务类型相对应。

此参数为调用CreateVideoCompressTask (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144048.html)或CreateGrabFrameTask (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199047.html)接口后返回的Task ID
parameters.name: task_id

EndTime.description_en:
The end time of the task.

This parameter has a value only when the task status is Finished. Otherwise, an empty value is returned
EndTime.description_zh:
任务的结束时间。

当任务状态为Finished时，此参数才有值，否则返回值为空

ErrorMessage.description_en:
The error message.

When the task status is Finished, the value of this parameter is fixed to Success. When the task status is Failed, refer to this value to troubleshoot the issue
ErrorMessage.description_zh:
错误信息。

当任务状态为Finished时，此参数的值固定为Success。当任务状态为Failed时，请参考此参数的值处理问题

NotifyEndpoint.description_en:
The endpoint for asynchronous reverse notification.

If this parameter is not specified when the task is created, an empty value is returned
NotifyEndpoint.description_zh:
异步反向通知的Endpoint。

如果创建任务时未设置此参数，则返回值为空

NotifyTopicName.description_en:
The TopicName for asynchronous reverse notification.

If this parameter is not specified when the task is created, an empty value is returned
NotifyTopicName.description_zh:
异步反向通知的TopicName。

如果创建任务时未设置此参数，则返回值为空

Parameters.description_en: The parameters used to create the task, in JSON format
Parameters.description_zh: 创建任务的参数，以JSON格式表示

Progress.description_en:
The task progress percentage. Currently, only two values are returned: 0 and 100.

This parameter returns 100 only when the conversion succeeds. In all other cases, the value is 0
Progress.description_zh:
任务进度的百分比。当前只有0和100两个结果。

只有当转换成功时，此参数的返回值才为100，其他情况均为0

Result.description_en:
The result of the task processing.

Different task types return different information. Refer to the actual response
Result.description_zh:
任务处理的结果。

不同的任务类型会有不同的返回信息，请以实际为准

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the task execution

Status.description_en:
The running status of the task. Valid values:

Running: The task is running.
Finished: The task is complete and the video is processed.
Failed: The task is complete but the video failed to be processed. For the specific failure cause, see the ErrorMessage value
Status.description_zh:
任务运行状态。包括如下选项：

Running：任务运行中。
Finished：任务执行完成，视频处理成功。
Failed：任务执行完成，视频处理失败。具体失败原因请参考ErrorMessage内容

TaskId.description_en: The task ID, which is the same as the one specified in the request

TaskType.description_en: The type of the task, which is the same as the one specified in the request
TaskType.description_zh: 任务的类型，和请求时一致
